text:
maya: Heads up — proposing a short final-cut preflight for v3.2 on Thu Mar 26 09:00 PT (16:00 UTC). Need quick RSVP + any last agenda bullets. Draft agenda: 1) cut window & owner confirmation 2) canary plan + replica scaling 3) DB migration checklist 4) rollback criteria 5) smoke owners and handoff
samir: +1 for 09:00, I'll own smoke and canary verification
cheng: conflict — customer demo 09:30-10:00 PT, can we do 10:30 instead? :thinking:
zoe: I can do either, prefer earlier if QA can prep
maya: We need to cut before EOD Fri so earlier helps. If 10:30 blocks QA we can look at 09:00. Who can own smoke tests?
samir: I'll own smoke + canary verification. Will post a short checklist here.
samir: Checklist snippet:
```
- deploy to canary
- run smoke.sh
- run latency-checker --threshold 200
- validate top-5 endpoints
```
ops-bot: Reminder: infra change cutoff is 2026-03-24 23:59 UTC
maya: @qa please confirm regression window availability
zoe: QA can cover 09:00 slot, but needs ~2h before cut for full regression. If we cut Thu evening it's tight.
cheng: there's one outstanding PR: https://github.com/redwood/pr/482 — needs review from @maya
maya: I'll review this afternoon
samir: tagging infra: @devops any capacity concerns for canary pool at 09:00 PT?
devops: infra looks OK, recommend increasing canary replicas to 3 for this run, will prepare autoscaler override
maya: added agenda item: 'scale canary replicas' and 'mute noisy alerts during canary'
maya: quick poll — react with ✅ for 09:00 PT, ⏭️ for 10:30 PT
zoe: ✅
samir: ✅
cheng: ⏭️
maya: 2 ✅ vs 1 ⏭️ — locking 09:00 PT. I'll send calendar invite and attach runbook + checklist in ~15m
maya: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v3.2-preflight
samir: I'll paste smoke results in this thread after canary run
zoe: QA roster: @ali and @nina will be on regression; they have the test matrix
maya: awesome, thanks. Final invite shortly — please update if anything blocks. :wave:
